findings.message: pytest 8.4.2: GHSA-6w46-j5rx-g56g (CVE-2025-71176, PYSEC-2026-1845); fixed in 9.0.3: pytest through 9.0.2 on UNIX relies on directories with the `/tmp/pytest-of-{user}` name pattern, which allows local users to cause a denial of service or possibly gain privileges.
